title: Writing / Voice / Voice qualities
slide_intent: Combine complementary voice qualities so a brand sounds human rather than repeating one exaggerated trait.
strategic_value: The four-part description can help Duolingo pair energy with support and broad cultural awareness.
demonstration: Four rows define Expressive, Playful, Embracing and Worldly beside a short explanation of how they work together.
practical_value: Evaluate a draft against the four qualities together instead of maximizing only playfulness.
